page.overview:
Who is Dinlas?

Dinlas is the illegitimate son of Aphrodite and Ares, and the God of Hatred and Chaos.

Aphrodite rejected her son, and banished him to live a life in pain and agony. With nothing to do with her bastard son, she casted him aside, and delivered him to Hades, God of the underworld. Hades found Dinlas, lying naked, torn and twisted, on his cold ebony floor. There, Hades foresaw a great anger in this little boy and decided to raise him as his own son. As Dinlas grew, his anger grew alongside him, and Hades had realized what could be done with him. Hades sent Dinlas to the mortal realm to be the divine guardian of Lamark, a city in which injured soldiers may rest and heal, then he farted into a glass cup then had a seizure and died.

Time would pass, and many warriors traveled to Lamark to heal. The city swarmed with the best physicians in all of Greece, some were even taught the divine art of healing by Asclepius himself. But soon Ares, the god of war, discovered this city, and cast his wrath upon Dinlas and the city of Lamark, as he did not want warriors to retreat from battle and instead, perish. Besides Asclepius' healing skills and his ability to awake the dead, was already frowned upon by fellow gods and goddesses. Ares persuaded Dinlas to crush Lamark, and was promised the golden lands and all Ares' spoils of war. Dinlas was easily tempted, and took Ares' offer, as it was a great one indeed. He traveled to the underworld, and went to the entrance of Hades' hall. There, Cerberus, the 3-headed beast, stood guarding the entrance. During his stay in the underworld, Dinlas had become quite fond of this creature. Cerberus respected Dinlas as well. Dinlas now released Cerberus and requested his assistance in destroying Lamark. Cerberus accepted, and followed Dinlas back to the city grounds.

Upon arrival, Dinlas commanded Cerberus to kill everybody, and lie the city in ruins. Dinlas would kill Asclepius himself, as a request by Ares. Fear, terror and agony ruled the lands of Lamark which gave room to Ares's valued twins,Phobos & Deimos. Soon enough, every soul in the city had been sent to Hades. Dinlas' deed was now completed.
